project_title: Gerador de Sinais IQ Option & PolariumBroker - Didi Fluxo Bot

identity_and_theme.archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Trading Terminal)
identity_and_theme.vibe: High-frequency precision, real-time signal command center, institutional dark mode with intense glowing CALL/PUT indicators

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (mandatory for live prices, timers, winrates, RSI, MACD values)
font_rules: Headings must be bold/black with tracking-tight
All numeric values (prices, win rates, RSI levels, countdown timers) MUST use font-mono and tabular-nums
Direction signals (CALL/PUT) must be uppercase text-3xl to text-5xl with heavy weight and glowing drop-shadow

layout_strategy.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Terminal Grid
layout_strategy.header: Sticky glassmorphism nav bar (bg-[#080A0F]/90 backdrop-blur-md) with Broker Connection Status, Account Type selector (DEMO/REAL), Timeframe dropdown (M1, M5, M15), and Live Scanning Toggle (INICIAR/PARAR ANÁLISE)
layout_strategy.main_grid: 3-column responsive layout: Left sidebar for Broker credentials & scanner parameters; Middle main panel for the HERO 'Melhor Ativo' (Best Asset) live signal card & strategy breakdown; Right sidebar for live market asset monitor feed & signal history log
layout_strategy.padding_philosophy: Compact yet distinct borders (p-4 md:p-6), strict 1px solid borders separating terminal regions instead of fuzzy shadows

confirmation_rules: RSI (14) na zona de confirmação de força
Agulhada do Didi (Didi Index: DI+ cruzando DI- no ponto de agulha)
strategy_engine_details.assets_scanned: Todos os pares Forex / OTC disponíveis na corretora em tempo real

component_guidelines.login_auth_screen: Clean dark card modal with JWT authentication, smooth tab switcher for Login/Cadastro, background subtended by grainy high-tech dark chart visuals.
component_guidelines.broker_connection_card: Connection panel with broker selector tabs (IQ Option / PolariumBroker), email/password inputs, API status badge (Conectado / Desconectado / Autenticando), and account balance display (BRL / USD).
component_guidelines.hero_best_asset_card: The center piece of the dashboard. Highlights the #1 ranked asset right now (e.g. EUR/USD OTC). Shows Signal Direction badge (COMPRA / CALL green or VENDA / PUT red), signal confidence gauge percentage (e.g. 94%), expiration timeframe (e.g. 5 Minutos), exact entry price, countdown to next candle, and 4 indicator confirmation lights.
indicator_status_badges: Agulhada do Didi: DI+ > DI- (AGULHADA CONFIRMADA)
component_guidelines.asset_scanner_list: Real-time scanning ticker list showing top 5-10 assets with their calculated confluence score, updated as the background scanner evaluates market ticks.
component_guidelines.signal_history_table: Table with filterable columns: Horário, Ativo, Corretora, Direção, Taxa de Entrada, Resultado (WIN / LOSS / PENDENTE), Assertividade Geral (%).
component_guidelines.micro_interactions: Animated pulse dot on active scanner; glowing border transition on signal change; sound toggle or audio alert indicator on high-confidence signal.

testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: High contrast text (#F8FAFC) on dark surfaces (#0F131C). Call buttons and badges use vivid green (#00E676) and red (#FF3D00) with dark text overlay or heavy contrast text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-facing UI text is written in natural Portuguese (pt-BR).

Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) or @phosphor-icons/react for indicators: TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Zap, ShieldCheck, RefreshCw, Radio, Activity, Cpu, Sliders, Play, Square, User, Lock, CheckCircle, AlertTriangle.
Implement Sonner toasts for connection status changes (e.g., 'Conectado à IQ Option com sucesso', 'Sinal detectado: EUR/USD CALL').

Include a dynamic simulated real-time market engine when live broker connection is in demo mode or active scanning mode, computing live MA9, MA21, MACD, RSI, and Didi Needle indicators across major forex pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/CAD, EUR/JPY, etc.).
Ensure every interactive element has its corresponding data-testid attribute.
